
## 2024-04-22 - [Optimizing Highlight String Splitting in React]
**Learning:** When using `String.prototype.split` with a capturing Regex in JavaScript, the resulting array interleaves the split segments with the captured matches. Specifically, the captured strings are always located at odd indices in the returned array.
**Action:** When mapping over fragments generated by a capturing split for text highlighting (e.g., in React), avoid O(N) linear lookups (`array.some(...)` or `array.includes(...)`) inside the O(M) `map` loop. Instead, use the O(1) mathematical check `index % 2 === 1` to instantly identify highlighted words, reducing the render complexity from O(M*N) to O(M).
